draft.quote: Two supertankers caught fire after hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz, Iran’s Revolutionary Guard has said, adding that the vessels were taking an “unauthorized route” through the conduit. In a statement to Iran’s state broadcaster, the paramilitary group said the ships were carrying over 4 million barrels of crude and attempting to traverse the southern section of Hormuz under the protection of the U.S. military.
draft.eventText: Iran's Revolutionary Guard says two supertankers caught fire after hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
